Meta.title: AutoExplore
Meta.author: Yuof
Meta.description:
[h1]AutoExplore Mod[/h1]
[b]Press [i]L[/i] to automatically explore the current map.[/b]
This mod includes the following features: [list] [*][b]Auto-fight[/b] [*][b]Auto-trap handling[/b] [*][b]Auto-loot collection[/b] [*][b]Auto-harvesting[/b] [*][b]Auto-mining[/b] [*][b]Auto-meditation[/b] [*][b]Auto-sleep[/b] [*][b]Auto-shrine handling[/b] [*][b]Auto-food consumption[/b] [/list]
[h2]Controls[/h2] [list] [*]Press [i]L + LeftShift[/i] to toggle between modes: [olist] [*]Explore [*]Gather [*]Mine [*]Combined [/olist]
[h2]Exclusion Lists[/h2] [i]Allows customization of items to be ignored during gathering and mining tasks.[/i] Configurable via the in-game rightlick menu(press shift) or directly in the config file: [list] [*]Add or remove items from the gathering exclusion list. [*]Add or remove items from the mining exclusion list. [/list]
[*]Keybinds available for moving up or down stairs. [/list]
[h2]Priority System[/h2] [i]Tasks are completed in the following order:[/i] [olist] [*]Fight visible enemies [*]Disarm visible traps [*]Explore and loot [/olist]
[h2]Configuration[/h2] [i]Includes an in-game configuration menu. (Press the middle button on your character to open the config.)[/i] Config file: [code]Elin\BepInEx\config\yuof.elin.autoExplore.mod.cfg[/code] Customizable settings include: [list] [*]Enable/disable fighting [*]Enable/disable trap handling [*]Enable/disable meditating [*]Enable/disable harvesting [*]Enable/disable mining [*]Enable/disable handling of shrines [*]Enable/disable handling of eating food [*]Set meditation thresholds [*]Set stamina thresholds [*]Customize keybinds [/list]
[h2]Tips[/h2] [list] [*]Set up your in-game auto-fight settings (found in the last tab of the character window). [*]Adjust the auto-stop setting to avoid running past enemies ([i]check screenshot for guidance[/i]). [*]Equip appropriate tools such as an axe or pickaxe for harvesting and mining. [/list]
[h2]Notes[/h2] [list] [*]The mod won't explore unreachable rooms. [*]If you are too tired to meditate, the mod will use a carried bed to prevent falling asleep. [*]Autoeat functionality uses the same logic as the in-game overmap eating. [/list]
